name: bark-notification
title: Bark 通知
usage: 在 Synapse 变量中配置好 BARK_ID 后，使用「手机通知我」「Bark 通知我」等触发 AI，向你的手机推送 Bark 通知。
description: Send a Bark phone push notification with a clear title and message. Use when the user asks to send a Bark notification, phone push, or iPhone push, or says "给我手机发消息", "给手机发信息", "bark通知我", "手机通知我", "发到我手机", or otherwise asks to be notified on their phone with a title and message.
